purpose: Measured per-part upgrade effects, captured from the in-game shop preview panel (absolute readouts). This is the specificity doctrine's data layer: exact menu names, exact numbers, no categories. Grows one engine at a time as builds get decoded.
method: Every row is read from the shop's Performance preview while highlighting the part (absolutes, not the green badge — the badge shows HP ONLY and hides torque). Deltas are computed against the named measurement base. CAVEAT: part effects interact (especially with aspiration), so deltas transfer only APPROXIMATELY to other bases — when solving builds, install and read absolutes; deltas are for planning.
display_rules: The green thumbnail badge ('POWER +X hp') omits torque entirely — never subset-hunt by badges, always read the preview panel's absolute pair.
Aspiration options are FAMILIES with Street/Sport/Race tiers; the Aspiration menu previews only each family's entry tier (tier-ladder rule, discovered on this car).
Some parts carry ZERO or NEGATIVE PI while adding power — the PI-efficiency stars below. These are near-mandatory on capped builds.
The top-left header PI LAGS behind part changes (read 798 while the true config previewed 790) — always trust the preview panel's PI, never the header.
The shop preview's Y Toggle cycles to an Aerodynamics panel showing per-option efficiency/balance/mech-balance — aero signatures are readable per part before buying.

PART PI COSTS ARE CONFIG-DEPENDENT: the PI simulation re-prices parts as the build changes (Viper ARBs previewed free at an early config, cost PI at the final 800-exact ledger). Every 'X PI' row in this table is valid AT ITS MEASUREMENT BASE; re-preview at the current config before trusting a ledger.

anti_roll_bars.finding: PI-FREE AT EVERY TIER (player-captured, cage-less stock-WR base): front stock/sport/race and rear stock/sport/race ALL preview S1 790 — zero PI across the ladder. Race bars also LIGHTER (front: 3,698 vs stock 3,703; rear sport 3,702/stock 3,703). Race ARBs = free sliders + free weight; never a give-back candidate.
anti_roll_bars.config_dependence: At the final near-800 config only ONE race bar fits the ledger (player report) — bars are not universally free; see config-dependence rule. ONE-BAR DOCTRINE: the adjustable bar sets the whole roll-balance ratio; choose the bar you'll push AWAY from stock. Viper fork verdict: REAR (anti-push direction = rear-stiffer, exit-traction = rear-softer — both rear-side moves; wing slider already covers rear aero; front managed via camber/psi).

rear_wing.finding: THE HEADLINE PART: 'Dodge - Stock Rear Wing' = MINUS 11 PI (798 wingless -> 787 winged), +14 lb, ADJUSTABLE badge (unlocks aero downforce sliders), 0 cr. The deepest negative-PI part measured in the project. FH6's base 2016 ACR configuration is WINGLESS ('Dodge - Remove Wing') — the wing must be installed. REVERSAL (2026-08-10, Y-toggle aero panel): the DONOR runs NO WING — its pane signature (0.57 balance / 0.798 efficiency) matches Remove Wing EXACTLY on two independent values. The donor PAID +11 PI for winglessness: a deliberate Goliath bet (top speed + 14 lb + agility over downforce) — the most expensive single choice in an otherwise ruthlessly PI-squeezed build. The wing remains a -11 PI gift for GRIP-philosophy builds; for the donor mimic it comes OFF. Also: the shop's Y-toggle shows per-part aero signatures (efficiency/balance/mech) — another preview instrument. RE-REVERSAL (player drove the donor — the wing is physically present and gigantic): ADJUSTABLE parts have signature RANGES, not points. The 0.44/0.764 reading is the wing at DEFAULT downforce; slid low, its signature approaches the wingless values — the donor runs the wing with rear downforce tuned far down (0.57/0.798). RULE: never fingerprint an adjustable part from one preview point. GIFT: the donor's aero sliders are menu-recoverable — install wing, adjust downforce until the panel reads 0.57/0.798 (wiggle-read); those positions ~= the donor's settings. First locked-tune slider values extracted without driving.

driveline.finding: Race Driveline = +1 PI, -11.2 lb vs stock (measured at race-WR base: stock 3,090/806, race 3,079/807). Nearly free like everything else on this chassis.

rims.finding: PLAYER-CONFIRMED (2026-08-10): the donor runs SUPER-HEAVY RIMS as PI BALLAST — heavy rims carry NEGATIVE PI (the formula discounts the mass penalty), funding engine/weight-reduction purchases elsewhere. The final piece of the donor ledger; also contributes to the 3,148 lb total. Known Forza-series minmax pattern, first FH6 player confirmation in this project.

donor_solution.finding_1: UNREACHABLE from Sport Centrifugal: with the complete menu measured, no part or additive combination lands +4/+8 (closest: Race Intake 839/731 — torque exact, hp 5 over; Sport Pistons 837/730). Player's report confirmed by exhaustive data.
donor_solution.finding_2: SOLVED AND PLAYER-VERIFIED 2026-08-10: STREET Centrifugal (757/669) + Race Intercooler (+58/+46) + Race Fuel System (+13/+12) + Race Oil/Cooling (+6/+5) = ~834/732 additive — hp exact, torque within 1 (interaction/rounding). Corroboration: intercooler+oil weight sits FORWARD (front% 52->53->54 with weight strip = donor's 54%); Race Oil's -2 PI fits the donor tuner's PI-squeezing pattern (rally suspension, rally tires).
donor_solution.verify: Swap aspiration to Street Centrifugal, install Race Intercooler + Race Fuel System + Race Oil/Cooling, read absolutes. Expect 834/731-732. Then weight ladder toward 3,148 (heavy strip ~-540 from that config) and PI to exactly 800.
donor_solution.verified: CONFIRMED IN-GAME: Street Centrifugal + Race Intercooler + Race Fuel System + Race Oil/Cooling = 834 hp / 731 ft-lb EXACT (pane-read). The additive delta model held to the digit across an aspiration-base transfer. First engine fully reverse-engineered from a locked tune via measured previews + subset-sum.
donor_solution.chassis_reconstruction: 2026-08-10: Race WR (+33 PI) proves the donor carries NO race brakes/ARBs/diff/cage — donor = engine + AWD + rally compound + rally S&D + Race WR + stock chassis parts = near-slider-less PI-max build (2nd confirmed instance of the pattern: top S1 tuners sell adjustability for weight/power). Player fork paths quantified: A exact-mimic (sell all extras, Race WR, ~3,134 @ <=800, no chassis sliders) / B balanced (sell cage + one family, Sport WR, ~3,412 @ ~800) / C current (3,665 @ 798, 517 lb tax). Pending: PI readouts of race brakes/ARBs/diff stock-downgrades to solve B exactly. REVISION: race-WR weights (3,134 WITH cage vs ~3,085 without) fit the donor's 3,148 far better WITH the cage — donor likely KEEPS the cage and closes 800 by running stock brakes + stock diff (combined ~31 PI from the 831 with-cage figure). ARBs are PI-free so the donor may well run race ARBs too. Pending: brake + diff stock-preview PIs — the final two numbers. BRAKES REMOVED from the model (no such part on this car). Give-back pool re-suspected: DIFF + TRANSMISSION (race 10-speed vs stock — never priced) + DRIVELINE. If those three sum ~28-31, donor = rally springs + race WR + free ARBs + factory brakes + STOCK drivetrain parts (slider-less philosophy fits stock gearbox; 214.2 top speed needs no custom gearing). Pending: three stock-preview PI readouts. PARADOX (2026-08-10): with diff/trans/ARBs proven PI-free and no brake parts, NOTHING measured explains the donor's ~28 PI gap below the race-WR previews (828-831). The engine combo for 834/731 is unique in the menu. Remaining unmeasured categories: DRIVELINE, TIRE WIDTHS (narrower = PI refund — classic hidden squeeze), RIMS, AERO options. The ~28 PI lives there; readouts pending. PARADOX RESOLVED (player recall, 2026-08-10): the player's car carries TIRE/RIM upgrades added during an earlier PI-fill attempt — the ~28 PI 'gap' is on OUR car, not missing from the donor's. Donor = race WR + stock widths/rims + free slider suite. Confirm via Tires & Rims stock-refund readouts; then the width-vs-weight choice (donor bet mass; the fork case is slow-corner grip, the ACR's one structural weakness). Reversible cheaply either way thanks to the free-slider chassis. WING RESOLVED (2026-08-10): stock adjustable wing = -11 PI; the replica had been running WINGLESS (FH6 base config) — the A/B handling gap was primarily missing rear downforce hardware, and the donor ledger gains 11 PI of previously invisible headroom.
donor_solution.final_manifest: COMPLETE (2026-08-10): Street Cent SC + Race IC + Race Fuel + Race Oil (834/731 exact) | AWD | stock driveline | rally compound + rally springs | cage | Race WR | HEAVY RIMS (PI ballast) | stock wing @ low downforce (0.57/0.798) | factory brakes | = S1 800 / 3,148 lb / 54%F. Every part recovered from a locked tune via compare-pane reads, shop-preview measurement, subset-sum, weight arithmetic, and signature-range matching — one day, zero guesses surviving unverified.

pi_efficiency_stars: Viper ACR 2016: Race Oil/Cooling (-2 PI, +6 hp/+5 tq), Sport Oil (-1 PI, +3/+3), Street Intercooler (0 PI, +13/+10), Race Flywheel (0 PI, -2 lb), Street Centrifugal SC (cheapest aspiration PI on both measured engines)

Pattern: oil/cooling family runs PI-negative on supercharged builds (2nd engine confirming); 10-speed race transmission lowest-PI box (player's gearbox rule) — check the discount per build, it was only 1 PI on the 4C

Viper ACR 2016: Rally Spring & Dampers cost 1 PI LESS than stock suspension while unlocking spring/damper/alignment sliders — negative-PI full suspension tuning. Generalize: check rally S&D pricing on every S1 build.
Viper ACR 2016: ANTI-ROLL BARS are PI-free at every tier and race bars are lighter than stock — free adjustability + free weight. Check ARB PI on every build before assuming they cost anything.

VIPER ACR HEADLINE: the ENTIRE slider set is PI-free — rally springs (-1 PI vs stock), ARBs free, differential free at all tiers, every transmission free (weight-only differences). The 4C's ~30-PI adjustability tax does not exist on this chassis; the ACR is structurally a tuner's car. Check per-car — the tax varies from ~30 PI (4C) to zero (ACR).

VIPER ACR CROWN JEWEL: the Stock Rear Wing is -11 PI with adjustable downforce sliders — the car pays you to take the aero. Completes the everything-free suite: springs -1, ARBs 0, diff 0, gearboxes 0, brakes native, wing -11.

HEAVY-RIM BALLAST (donor Viper, player-confirmed): deliberately heavy rims = negative PI — buy PI with corner mass and spend it on power/weight-reduction where the exchange rate profits. The fourth PI-arbitrage pattern documented (rally compound, rally springs, negative-PI parts, heavy rims).

Centenario: Rally springs = PI-parity with stock while unlocking three slider families (2nd car); rally/drift/race diffs PI-free (3rd car); 9/10-speed race boxes BELOW race-base PI; race rear wing ~13 PI cheaper than the stock wing (2nd negative-PI wing).
